title: UNIVERSAL MUSIC REPRESENTATIONS? EVALUATING FOUNDATION MODELS ON WORLD MUSIC CORPORA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating audio foundation models on the automatic music tagging task across six culturally diverse music corpora (Western popular, Greek folk, Turkish-makam, and Indian classical) using probing, supervised fine-tuning, and multi-label few-shot learning to assess cross-cultural generalization and Western-centric performance disparities.
